content.short: Business transaction account, cards and payments acceptance.
content.description: Zeller is an Australian financial platform for businesses that combines payment acceptance with banking, cards, and expense tools in one ecosystem. It offers EFTPOS terminals and point-of-sale hardware for taking card payments, a free business transaction account, physical and virtual Mastercard debit cards for teams, invoicing, and a dashboard that ties sales, spending, and cash flow together. Zeller targets small and medium businesses, retailers, and hospitality operators that want an alternative to traditional bank merchant services and business accounts, with fast settlement and integrated reporting. By bringing together payments acceptance, accounts, and cards for the same customer, Zeller positions itself as an all-in-one financial platform for Australian businesses, competing with incumbent banks and other fintechs on pricing, hardware, and ease of use.
